entities.summary: Ronald Michael Carroll was an American DJ, singer, songwriter and music producer. He was primarily active in the house music circuit and openly gay. Ron was a proponent for the LGBTQ+ and HIV Positive communities, having disclosed his own diagnosis just weeks before his death.
